items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And we went to these places. And we played on weekends. ... Professor Longhair was popular about playing these places. And we went to these places.

ctx.x: I remember the last place we played, the San Jacinto, 19-something. But then after, you know when I got a little bit older then, we drifted off into other things. And Professor Longhair went on to other things too. I didn't play with him in his later years.
In the 70s, because I knew all his money in the 70s.
